params.description: Comma-separated list of instrument IDs to retrieve market rates for. Each ID represents a unique tradable asset in the system.

items.docs: Provides real-time market data including bid/ask prices, conversion rates, and execution prices for specified financial instruments. Essential for price discovery and trade execution decisions.

info.name: Get historical candles data for an instrument

params.name: direction
params.description: Sorting direction of the candles data. Use 'asc' for oldest to newest, or 'desc' for newest to oldest.

params.name: interval
params.description: Time interval for each candle. Determines the granularity of the price data. Shorter intervals provide more detailed price action but require more data points.

params.name: candlesCount
params.description: Number of candles to retrieve. Maximum value is 1000. For longer historical periods, consider using a larger time interval or making multiple requests.

params.name: instrumentId
params.description: Unique identifier of the financial instrument to retrieve candles for. This ID is consistent across all eToro systems.

items.docs: Retrieves historical price data in OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) format for a specified instrument. The data is organized into time-based candles of various intervals, from one minute to one week.

params.name: searchText
params.description: Text to search for within instrument names.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of results to return per page.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: The page number to retrieve for pagination.

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Example: pop=popularityUniques7Day,displayname

params.name: sort
params.description: The field to sort by, with direction (asc/desc). Example: popularityUniques7Day desc

items.docs: Retrieve a list of instruments based on various search criteria. Each field in the response can be utilized as a filter or projection.
